inputs.original_text: Hyderabad: Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) Working President KT Rama Rao (KTR) on Sunday, March 29, accused the Congress government of corruption and failing to act against illegal mining. KTR alleged that Raghava Constructions, a company belonging to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy is involved in illegal mining. The Sircilla MLA questioned ... Get the latest updates in Hyderabad City News , Technology , Entertainment , Sports , Politics and Top Stories on WhatsApp & Telegram by subscribing to our channels. You can also download our app for Android and iOS .
inputs.modified_text: KT Rama Rao, the BRS Working President, accused the Congress government of corruption and deliberately failing to stop illegal mining, calling out Raghava Constructions owned by Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy as part of it, during events on Sunday, March 29 in Hyderabad. This is yet another case of these progressive governments showing weakness in upholding law and order, letting connected interests exploit resources while proper authority should be protecting the nation's integrity and social stability. The push for some kind of institutional overhaul to chase labor rights and supposed historical fixes is just more of the same misguided thinking that erodes personal responsibility and traditional values. What is needed instead is stronger leadership that enforces accountability, prioritizes national order, and rejects the cultural drift that allows such failures to persist.
